title: DemoFoundry: Toward Scalable Photorealistic Robot Data with Coding Agents and Generative Rendering
abstract: arXiv:2611.34671v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Scaling robot learning requires demonstrations that combine realistic visual observations with reliable action supervision. Simulation-based synthesis faces a substantial visual gap relative to real environments, while video-only generation struggles to maintain physically consistent interactions and provide aligned action labels. We present DemoFoundry, an automated framework that couples coding agents with generative rendering to synthesize photorealistic and physically grounded robot demonstrations. Coding agents both construct aligned real--proxy video pairs from existing robot episodes to train a video renderer and write executable interaction programs to generate new demonstrations. Given a scene reference and task instruction, an agent reconstructs task-relevant geometry and writes a control program without requiring target-task human demonstrations. translated_title: DemoFoundry：利用编程代理与生成式渲染迈向可扩展的照片级逼真机器人数据
translated_abstract: 扩展机器人学习需要同时具备真实视觉观测与可靠动作监督的演示数据。基于仿真的合成方法相对于真实环境存在显著的视觉差距，而仅依靠视频生成的方法则难以维持物理一致的交互并提供对齐的动作标签。我们提出了DemoFoundry，这是一个自动化框架，它将编程代理与生成式渲染相结合，以合成照片级逼真且具有物理基础的机器人演示数据。编程代理一方面从现有机器人操作片段中构建对齐的真实-代理视频对来训练视频渲染器，另一方面编写可执行的交互程序来生成新的演示。给定场景参考和任务指令，代理能够重建与任务相关的几何结构并编写控制程序，而无需目标任务的人类演示。在物理仿真器中执行程序即可产生带有对齐机器人动作标签的代理视频。
tldr: DemoFoundry通过结合编程代理与生成式渲染，自动合成兼具照片级真实感视觉与物理一致动作监督的机器人演示数据，无需目标任务人类演示即可实现大规模机器人数据生成。
en_tdlr: DemoFoundry couples coding agents with generative rendering to automatically synthesize photorealistic, physically grounded robot demonstrations at scale, without requiring human demonstrations for target tasks.
